prompt:
Balance the combustion of propane:

$\text{C}_3\text{H}_8+\underline{\phantom{x}}\ \text{O}_2\rightarrow3\,\text{CO}_2+4\,\text{H}_2\text{O}$

What coefficient belongs in front of $\text{O}_2$?
teacher_notes: Have students verify carbon and hydrogen counts as well, not just oxygen.
explanation: Count the oxygen atoms on the product side: $3\,\text{CO}_2$ contributes 6 oxygen atoms and $4\,\text{H}_2\text{O}$ contributes 4, for 10 in total. Since each $\text{O}_2$ molecule supplies 2 oxygen atoms, 5 molecules are required. The balanced equation is $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8+5\,\text{O}_2\rightarrow3\,\text{CO}_2+4\,\text{H}_2\text{O}$, and mass is conserved.
